missing: apply only an admitted default, preserving default provenance
parser: A parser name must match the resolved source carrier; it cannot switch the host parser.
filepath: Canonical resolved source only; no disk discovery.
plugins: Only empty plugins/pluginSearchDirs arrays; no execution or lookup.
rangeEnd: source-end is the pinned positive-infinity sentinel; bind to the exact authored source length during admission.
deprecated: jsxBracketSameLine is explicitly unsupported; use bracketSameLine.

config_envelope.ignore: captured ignore data only; matched files return skipped
config_envelope.overrides: captured ordered selector/provenance records; no private discovery
config_envelope.config: captured config only; formatter executes no code

option_sets: Family option sets select their applicable language subset, recorded in each exact expectation. The inapplicable-rejected set deliberately does not filter. Sets are finite admitted configurations, not the infinite Cartesian product of numeric options.
